blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Background. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated on clinical tasks, but exam-style accuracy says little about whether a model reasons well over a patient’s record. Clinical reasoning, operationalised here as the structured process of integrating and updating information across time and evidence sources to form, revise and justify a representation of a patient’s problem and a defensible plan, is a different construct from answer correctness, and it is not obvious that any existing instrument measures it. Aim. To map the rubrics and benchmarks that could be used to score clinical reasoning in LLM outputs, to state precisely which components of the construct each one measures, and to identify what must be combined or newly built to evaluate reasoning over longitudinal, multi-document clinical records. Approach. A structured narrative review of three literatures: medical education instruments developed to assess human learners (IDEA, R-IDEA, ART, the Script Concordance Test); clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards (including HealthBench, MedR-Bench, TIMER-Eval, ER-Reason, SCT-Bench, MedThink-Bench and recent uncertainty, counterfactual and omission benchmarks); and general-domain evaluation methodology for long-form generation (LLM-as-judge, checklist decomposition, importance-aware factuality, judge reliability audits). Preprints are included and flagged. Findings. No single instrument captures the construct. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning
are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument
and assessment setting. TIMER-Eval directly targets temporal synthesis, while ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated evaluations of uncertainty preservation and
counterfactual robustness are emerging, but their applicability
to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in the general domain, where omission rather than fabrication is the dominant failure mode, with early clinical confirmation. Reasoning faithfulness remains the weakest dimension: we identified one clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions. Implications. Existing tools should be used only for the parts they actually measure, and joined using five methodological commitments: binary compilation of rubric items, separation of completeness from correctness, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, order-consistency checks for the temporal axis, and chance-corrected reliability reporting throughout. Genuine design work remains for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models are now routinely evaluated on medical tasks, and the dominant instruments remain multiple-choice examinations and short-answer question sets. These are automatable and reproducible, but their construct validity for clinical work is poor: Alaa and colleagues show that, for a frontier model, correctness on exam items only weakly predicts correctness on real clinical cases, and that model rankings can reverse when the same models are assessed on cases derived from health records ( Alaa et al., 2025 ) . A benchmark optimised for exam accuracy may therefore rank models in the wrong order for the tasks that matter clinically. The natural response is to score the reasoning rather than the answer. That response immediately raises two problems: what exactly is being scored, and whether any existing rubric or benchmark scores it.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型现在被例行地评价医疗任务,主导工具仍然是多选择考试和短答问题集. 这些是可自发的和可复制的,但它们对于临床工作的构造有效性很差: Alaa和同事表明,就前沿模型而言,对检查项目的正确性只能对真实临床病例的正确性作出微弱的预测,当对从健康记录中得出的病例评估出相同的模型时,模型排名可以逆转(Alaa等人,2025年). 因此,对考试准确性进行优化的基准可能对临床上重要的任务按错误顺序排列模型。 自然的反应是给推理分分而不是给答案. 这一反应立即提出了两个问题:确切的得分,以及是否有任何现有的标点或基准得分。

blocks.en: The first problem is definitional. There is no agreed definition of clinical reasoning in the medical education literature, and this is itself a settled finding rather than a gap in reading ( Young et al., 2018 ) . The work reviewed here therefore does not attempt a general definition. It commits to a narrower operational one: clinical reasoning is the structured cognitive process by which a reasoner integrates and updates information across time and evidence sources to form, revise and justify representations of a patient’s clinical problem, and to generate defensible decisions about further investigation and management. That definition is deliberately scoped to reasoning from documented evidence, and in particular to reasoning over longitudinal, multi-document electronic health records in which later entries may legitimately supersede, rather than merely supplement, earlier ones. It decomposes into six measurable dimensions: problem representation; temporal or longitudinal synthesis; counterfactual reasoning; differential and management reasoning; calibrated uncertainty; and the faithfulness of stated reasoning to the process that actually produced the output. Whether stated reasoning is faithful is included because, in the LLM setting, a coherent rationale cannot be assumed to be an account of how the answer was generated ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 第一个问题是定义问题。 医学教育文献中没有关于临床推理的一致定义,这本身就是一个固定的发现,而不是一个阅读上的空白(Young等人,2018年). 因此,本文审查的工作并不试图作出一般性定义。 它承诺缩小操作范围:临床推理是一个结构化的认知过程,通过这个过程,一个理性者将各种时间和证据来源的信息整合和更新,以形成、修改和证明病人临床问题的陈述,并就进一步调查和管理作出合理的决定。 这一定义被刻意限定为从有据可查的证据中推理,特别是从纵向、多文件电子健康记录中推理,在这些记录中,以后的条目可以合法地取代而不是仅仅补充以前的记录。 它分解为六个可测量的维度:问题表述;时间或纵向综合;反事实推理;差异与管理推理;校准不确定性;以及声明推理对实际产生产出的过程的忠实性. 所陈述的推理是否忠实,也包括在内,因为在LLM环境中,不能假定一个连贯的推理是说明答案是如何生成的(Turpin等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: The second problem, whether an existing instrument measures this construct, is the subject of this paper. The question is narrower than “how good are medical LLMs” and more practical than a taxonomy of evaluation methods. It asks, for each candidate rubric or benchmark, what it actually measures, what it does not, and what would need to be added or combined to score reasoning over serial clinical records. The answer matters for anyone planning to evaluate or fine-tune models on longitudinal clinical text, because the tools most often cited for this purpose were built for other jobs, and their labels do not always match their contents.
blocks.zh: 第二个问题,即现有文书是否衡量这一构想,是本文件的主题。 这个问题比“医学法学硕士”要窄,比评价方法的分类更为实用。 它询问,对于每个候选项目或基准,它实际衡量什么,它没有衡量什么,以及需要增加什么或合并什么来比连环临床记录的分数推理. 对于任何计划评价或微调纵向临床文本模型的人来说,答案很重要,因为为此目的最常引用的工具是为其他工作而建造的,其标签并不总是与内容相符.

blocks.en: 2 Scope and approach
blocks.zh: 2. 范围和办法

blocks.en:
This is a structured narrative review rather than a systematic review. Sources were identified through PubMed, the ACL Anthology, arXiv and Semantic Scholar, with forward and backward citation chasing from the core instruments, and screened by a single reviewer. The review considers LLM evaluation work published from 2023
onwards, with no lower date bound for medical education instruments. Preprints are included because the LLM evaluation literature moves largely through them; each is flagged in the text and the reference list, and findings from preprints are treated as provisional. No quantitative synthesis is attempted. Source selection was purposive and iterative rather than exhaustive. A complete search log was not retained, limiting reproducibility. The review is therefore best read as a reasoned map of the field against a stated construct, not as an exhaustive inventory.
blocks.zh:
这是一个结构化的叙述性审查,而不是系统的审查。 来源通过PubMed,ACL Anthology,arXiv和语义学者(英语:Semantic Scholar)确定,前向和后向的引用从核心乐器追逐,由单一的评审员进行筛选. 审查考虑了2023年公布的LLM评价工作.
从此以后,医疗教育仪器的日期没有降低。 列入预印件是因为LLM评价文献大多通过它们移动;在文本和参考列表中分别标注,预印件的结论作为暂定. 未尝试定量合成. 源的选择是目的性的和反复性的,而不是详尽无遗的。 完整搜索日志没有保留,限制了可复制性。 因此,这一审查最好被理解为一份与所述结构相对应的实地合理地图,而不是一份详尽无遗的清单。

blocks.en: Three adjacent literatures were considered but are not the focus of this review. The clinical decision support systems literature evaluates whether tools change clinical behaviour or outcomes, not the quality of reasoning steps, and is therefore out of scope here ( Wright and Sittig, 2008 ) . The verbal protocol and think-aloud literature from cognitive science underpins much of clinical reasoning theory, but it provides a data collection method rather than a scoreable rubric, and is not designed for post-hoc assessment of static text outputs ( Fonteyn et al., 1993 ; Pinnock et al., 2015 ) . The diagnostic error and patient safety literature offers retrospective tools for categorising errors after the fact, but is concerned with outcome rather than reasoning process ( Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality, n.d. ; Singh and Sittig, 2015 ) . The remainder of this review therefore focuses on the traditions that most directly bear on the evaluation task at hand.
blocks.zh: 会议审议了三个相邻的文献,但并不是本次审查的重点。 临床决策支持系统文献评价工具是否改变临床行为或结果,而不是推理步骤的质量,因此在此超出范围(Wright and Sittig, 2008.). 认知科学的口头协议和思想-aloud文献支撑了临床推理理论的大部分,但它提供了一个数据收集方法而不是一个可评分的标点,并非为静态文本输出的后期评估而设计的(Fonteyn等人,1993年;Pinnock等人,2015年)。 诊断错误和患者安全文献提供了事后分类错误的追溯工具,但关注的是结果而不是推理过程(医疗保健研究和质量局,n.d.;Singh and Sittig, 2015). 因此,本次审查的其余部分侧重于当前评价工作最直接涉及的传统。

blocks.en: 3 The landscape in outline
blocks.zh: 3个 概况

blocks.en: There is not currently one single rubric or benchmark in the literature reviewed here that captures the version of clinical reasoning defined above ( Baker et al., 2015 ; Schaye et al., 2022 ; Thammasitboon et al., 2018 ; Lubarsky et al., 2013 ; Arora et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Mehandru et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Jeong et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Adewuyi et al., 2026 ; Oukelmoun et al., 2025 ; Meincke et al., 2026 ) . Instead, the literature falls into three fairly separate strands: medical education tools developed to assess human learners, newer benchmarks developed to assess large language model outputs, and a general-domain evaluation-methodology literature that determines whether any rubric can be applied reliably at scale ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Min et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Ruan et al., 2025 ; Jafari et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wanner et al., 2025 ; Norman et al., 2026 ; Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ; Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ) . These strands overlap to some extent, but they are not doing the same job. Each is taken in turn below, followed by a dimension-by-dimension account of what is covered, partially covered and missing, and a statement of what needs to be combined.
blocks.zh: 本文所审查的文献目前没有一个单一的标点或基准可以捕捉上述临床推理版本(Baker等人,2015年;Schaye等人,2022年;Thammasitboon等人,2018年;Lubarsky等人,2013年;Arora等人,2025年;邱等人,2025年;Cui等人,2025年;Mehandru等人,2025年;Gao等人,2023年;Jeong等人,2024年;Du等人,2026年;Adewuyi等人,2026年;Oukelmoun等人,2025年;Meincke等人,2026年)。 相反,文献分为三个相当独立的部分:为评估人类学习者而开发的医学教育工具,为评估大型语言模型产出而开发的较新的基准,以及确定任何标题是否能够可靠地在规模上应用的一般领域评价方法文献(Liu等人,2023年;Zheng等人,2023年;Kim等人,2023年)。 ;Ye等人,2024年;Min等人,2023年;Song等人,2024年;Wei等人,2024年;Lee等人,2025年;Ruan等人,2025年;Jafari等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Wanner等人,2025年;Norman等人,2026年;Rao和Calison-Burch,2026年;Jacovi和Goldberg,2020年). 这些方面在某种程度上是重叠的,但它们并没有做同样的工作。 下文逐一介绍,然后逐一介绍所涵盖、部分涵盖和缺失的内容,并阐述需要合并的内容。

blocks.en: 4 The medical education strand
blocks.zh: 页:1 医学教育

blocks.en:
The genealogy of the most directly useful tools begins with the original IDEA assessment tool, developed by Baker and colleagues to score clinical reasoning documentation across four domains: interpretive summary, differential diagnosis, explanation of reasoning, and alternatives ( Baker et al., 2015 ) . IDEA is worth citing in its own right, and not only as the ancestor of its revision, because its validity evidence already documents the central problem this review is concerned with. The original IDEA studies reported moderate inter-rater reliability for reporting, diagnostic reasoning and decision-making scores
(ICCs 0.53, 0.64 and 0.63, respectively), supporting formative rather than high-stakes use ( Baker et al., 2015 ) . These are study-specific estimates, not an upper bound on reasoning-assessment reliability.
Revised-IDEA subsequently reported an ICC of 0.84 (95% CI 0.74–0.90) ( Schaye et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
最直接有用的工具的家族学开始于最初的IDEA评估工具,由贝克和同事开发,以在四个领域对临床推理文献进行分数:解释性摘要,差异性诊断,推理解释,和替代品(Baker等人,2015年). 民主选举学会本身就值得援引,而不只是作为修订它的祖先,因为其有效性证据已经证明了本次审查所关注的中心问题。 最初的民主选举学会研究报告了报告、诊断推理和决策分数的适度可靠度
(ICCs 0.53, 0.64和0.63),支持成型而不是高吸量使用(Baker等人,2015年)。 这些是针对具体研究的估计,而不是推理评估可靠性的上限。
修订后,IDEA报告电算中心为0.84(95%CI 0.74–0.90)(Schaye等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: That fragility is precisely what motivated Revised-IDEA, referred to here as R-IDEA. Schaye and colleagues redesigned the instrument to assess clinical reasoning documentation in admission notes with improved reliability, retaining the four-part structure of interpretive summary, differential diagnosis, explanation, and alternatives ( Schaye et al., 2022 ) . In practice, what R-IDEA measures is how well reasoning is written down in a clinical note. That makes it useful for problem representation and parts of differential reasoning, but it does not assess temporal reasoning across serial records, calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning, or whether the written explanation actually drove the answer.
blocks.zh: 这种脆弱性恰恰是《修订-IDEA》的动机,这里称之为《修订-IDEA》。 Schaye和同事重新设计了该仪器,以更加可靠的方式评估入院笔记中的临床推理文件,保留了解释性摘要、差异性诊断、解释和替代办法的四部分结构(Schaye等人,2022年)。 在实践中,R-IDEA的衡量标准是在临床说明中写下推理有多好. 这使得它对于问题表述和差异推理的部分内容有用,但它并没有评估跨序列记录的时间推理,校准不确定性,反事实推理,或者书面解释是否实际驱动答案.

blocks.en: ART is useful for a slightly different reason. It was designed as a theory-informed tool for assessing diagnostic reasoning and feedback, and includes areas such as problem representation, prioritised differential reasoning, and metacognition ( Thammasitboon et al., 2018 ) . Its value here is not that it solves model evaluation, but that it shows how medical educators try to break reasoning into visible parts that can be discussed and judged. Even so, ART still assesses human performance in presentation-based settings, and its metacognitive elements only really work if the speaker is assumed to be sincerely describing their own uncertainty or revision of thought.
blocks.zh: ART由于一个略有不同的原因是有用的. 它被设计为评估诊断推理和反馈的理论知情工具,包括问题表述,优先差别推理,以及元识别等领域(Thammasitboon等人,2018年). 它在这里的价值不在于它能解决模型评价,而在于它显示了医学教育者如何试图把推理突破成可以讨论和判断的可见部分. 即便如此,ART仍然在基于演示的环境下评估人类的性能,只有当演讲者被假定为真诚描述他们自己的不确定性或思想修正时,其元认知要素才真正发挥作用.

blocks.en: The Script Concordance Test (SCT) is narrower again. It looks at how new information changes the plausibility of a hypothesis under uncertainty by comparing responses with those of an expert panel ( Lubarsky et al., 2013 ) . That makes it relevant to structured judgement under uncertainty, but it has not traditionally been used as a general rubric for open-ended clinical reasoning text. The paradigm has recently been scaled for model evaluation: McCoy and colleagues assembled a public benchmark of 750 validated SCT items drawn from ten international datasets and compared ten state-of-the-art models against a human baseline of students, residents, and attending physicians ( McCoy et al., 2025 ) . Performance tracked clinical expertise, yet even reasoning-optimised models scored substantially lower on SCT than on conventional multiple-choice examinations, and response-pattern analysis showed systematic overconfidence, with models disproportionately favouring extreme belief shifts (+2 or − - 2) and underusing neutral ratings ( McCoy et al., 2025 ) . This suggests that chain-of-thought optimisation may encourage premature commitment rather than flexible probabilistic updating. Scaled SCT therefore exposes gaps in belief revision under uncertainty, but remains a deliberately constrained proxy: it supports a separate belief-updating task and supplies convergent evidence, but does not convert free-text uncertainty handling into an SCT score.
blocks.zh: 脚本协和测试(SCT)再次缩小. 它研究了新信息如何通过比较专家小组的答复来改变不确定性下假设的合理性(Lubarsky等人,2013年)。 这使得它与不确定性下的结构化判断相关,但传统上它不被用作开放式临床推理文本的总标题. 最近对模式评价进行了扩大: McCoy和同事从10个国际数据集中收集了750个经验证的SCT项目的公共基准,并将10个最新模型与学生、居民和主治医生的人类基线进行比较(McCoy等人,2025年)。 业绩跟踪临床专业知识,但即使是推理优化模型在SCT上的得分也大大低于常规的多选择检查,反应模式分析显示出系统性的过度自信,模型不成比例地倾向于极端的信仰转变(+2或−-2),并低估了中性评级(McCoy等人,2025年)。 这表明,思维优化链可能鼓励过早的承诺,而不是灵活地更新概率。 因此,缩放的SCT在不确定性下暴露了信仰修正中的空白,但仍然是一个故意受限的代名词:它支持单独的信仰更新任务,并提供趋同的证据,但不将自由文本的不确定性处理转换成SCT分数.

blocks.en: Taken together, the medical education literature is strongest when the task is to assess how a human learner frames a problem, prioritises a differential, and justifies a plan ( Baker et al., 2015 ; Schaye et al., 2022 ; Thammasitboon et al., 2018 ; Lubarsky et al., 2013 ) . Its main limitation for the present purpose is structural: these tools generally assume that what someone writes or says can be treated as a meaningful account of their reasoning ( Baker et al., 2015 ; Schaye et al., 2022 ; Thammasitboon et al., 2018 ; Lubarsky et al., 2013 ) . The IDEA validity work shows that this assumption was already under strain for human authors ( Baker et al., 2015 ) ; it becomes much shakier still when the object being assessed is an LLM output rather than a trainee note or presentation.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,医学教育文献最强,任务是评估人类学习者如何确定问题,确定差异的优先顺序,并证明计划合理(Baker等人,2015年;Schaye等人,2022年;Thammasitboon等人,2018年;Lubarsky等人,2013年)。 它对目前目的的主要限制是结构性的:这些工具一般认为,人们所写或所说的话可以被视为对其推理的有意义的阐述(Baker等人,2015年;Schaye等人,2022年;Thammasitboon等人,2018年;Lubarsky等人,2013年)。 民主选举学会的有效性工作显示,这一假设对于人类作者来说已经很紧张(Baker等人,2015年);当被评估的物体是LLM输出而不是见习笔记或演示时,这种假设就变得更加不稳定。

blocks.en: 5 The clinical LLM benchmark strand
blocks.zh: 页:1 临床LLM基准线

blocks.en: The recent LLM evaluation literature starts from a different place ( Arora et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Mehandru et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Jeong et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Adewuyi et al., 2026 ; Oukelmoun et al., 2025 ; Meincke et al., 2026 ) . Most of these benchmarks are designed to judge the quality, safety, completeness, or usefulness of a model’s answer, rather than to assess clinical reasoning in a mechanism-based reasoning used in medical education. HealthBench is a good example. It uses physician-authored rubrics to score healthcare conversations across dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, communication, context-awareness, and instruction-following, with individually weighted criteria that can carry negative weights for harmful content ( Arora et al., 2025 ) . What it gives you, then, is a structured way of judging clinically relevant answers, and its weighting machinery is a useful precedent for the importance-weighted approach set out below. What it does not obviously give you is a full rubric for clinical reasoning in the narrower sense defined above. This produces the situation where models may reach the correct answer with flawed reasoning, resulting in brittle overfitting models.
blocks.zh: 最近的LLM评价文献起源于另一个地方(Arora等人,2025年;Quu等人,2025年;Cui等人,2025年;Mehandru等人,2025年;Gao等人,2023年;Jeong等人,2024年;Du等人,2026年;Adewuyi等人,2026年;Oukelmoun等人,2025年;Meincke等人,2026年)。 这些基准大多旨在判断模型答案的质量、安全性、完整性或有用性,而不是在医学教育中使用的机制推理中评估临床推理。 健康奔驰是一个很好的例子。 它使用医生授权的标语来评分保健对话的方方面面,如准确性、完整性、沟通、环境意识和遵循指示,并配有个别加权标准,可对有害内容负重(Arora等人,2025年)。 因此,它给大家的是一个有条理的判断临床相关答案的方法,其加权机制是以下所列重要性加权方法的有用先例。 它显然没有给你一个完整的标题 临床推理 狭义的上面定义。 这就产生了模型可能以有缺陷的推理得出正确答案的情况,导致模型过于适应。

blocks.en: MedR-Bench gets closer to reasoning-focused evaluation. It uses 1,453 structured patient cases with reference reasoning derived from case reports, comprising 957 diagnosis cases and 496 treatment-planning cases, including a substantial rare-disease subset ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) . That makes it more informative than short-answer medical question-answering benchmarks, because it compares generated reasoning against structured case material rather than only checking the final answer. Even so, it still assesses correspondence to reference reasoning and properties of the written rationale, not whether the stated reasoning steps actually caused the answer. For that reason, it is best treated here as a partial proxy for reasoning quality rather than as a solution to the faithfulness problem.
blocks.zh: Medr-Bench更接近以推理为重点的评价. 它使用1 453个结构化病人病例,参考案例报告,包括957个诊断病例和496个治疗规划病例,包括大量罕见病子集(邱等人,2025年)。 这使其比简短的医学问题回答基准更具有信息性,因为它将生成的推理与结构化的案件材料相比较,而不只是检查最后的答案。 即使如此,它仍然将对应书评为参考推理和书面推理的属性,而不是所陈述的推理步骤是否实际导致了答案. 因此,这里最好把它作为推理质量的部分代名词,而不是作为忠实问题的解决方案.

blocks.en: TIMER is the clearest example of a benchmark adding something distinct, though it needs to be characterised precisely. TIMER combines temporally grounded instruction tuning with an evaluation schema, TIMER-Eval, for longitudinal clinical records. Instruction-response pairs are linked to timestamps in patient records, while TIMER-Eval assesses questions requiring synthesis across multiple timepoints ( Cui et al., 2025 ) . The evaluation component looks at whether model outputs respect temporal boundaries, identify trends correctly, and preserve chronological order. This matters because temporal reasoning is often mentioned in general terms in the clinical reasoning literature, but is rarely measured directly in a scored tool. TIMER-Eval therefore looks genuinely useful for the temporal component of a clinical reasoning rubric. Two limits should be stated. First, it measures temporal reasoning performance, not the whole of clinical reasoning. Second, the temporal distribution of evaluation items requires attention: the earlier MedAlign benchmark is heavily recency-weighted, with 55.3% of instructions referring to the final quarter of the timeline, and TIMER-Eval addresses this by explicitly providing Edge and Uniform temporal distributions ( Cui et al., 2025 ) . Even so, it does not explicitly test whether a model recognises that a later record supersedes, rather than merely supplements, an earlier one. That distinction, between accumulation and legitimate supersession, is a defining feature of serial clinical records, and it remains untested even after TIMER.
blocks.zh: TimeR是基准增加不同内容的最明显的例子,尽管需要精确说明。 TimeR将基于时间的指令调谐与评价计划TimeR-Eval相结合,用于纵向临床记录. 指令-响应对与患者记录中的时间戳相连,而TIEMR-Eval则评估需要跨多个时点合成的问题(Cui等人,2025年). 评价部分审查示范产出是否尊重时间界限,正确确定趋势,并保持时间顺序。 这一点很重要,因为临床推理文献中常常泛泛地提到时间推理,但很少直接在得分的工具中衡量. 因此,TimeR-Eval看起来对临床推理题的时间成分真正有用。 应当说明两个限度。 首先,它衡量的是时间推理表现,而不是整个临床推理. 第二,评价项目的时间分布需要注意:早期的MedAlign基准是重度加权的,其中55.3%的指令提到时间表的最后一个季度,TimeR-Eval通过明确提供边缘和统一的时间分布来解决这一问题(Cui等人,2025年)。 即使如此,它也没有明确检验一种模式是否承认后期记录取代而不是仅仅补充早先的记录。 这种区分,即积累和合法的超会话,是系列临床记录的一个决定性特征,即使在TimeR之后,它仍然没有得到检验.

However, these structured tasks do not establish the faithfulness

blocks.en: This sequential-workflow paradigm has been extended and validated against clinician cohorts in several 2026 studies. Brodeur and colleagues tested an advanced model against a baseline of several hundred physicians across five clinical reasoning experiments (differential diagnosis generation, display of reasoning, triage differential, probabilistic reasoning, and management reasoning), adjudicated by expert physicians with validated psychometrics, and complemented these with a real-world emergency department trial comparing human and model second opinions at a tertiary academic centre ( Brodeur et al., 2026 ) . The model matched or exceeded physician performance on text-based triage and reasoning under uncertainty, but remained bounded by its text-only input and absence of bedside multimodal cues ( Brodeur et al., 2026 ) . That boundary applies equally to any evaluation, including the one motivating this review, that scores reasoning from text alone.
blocks.zh: 在2026年的几项研究中,这一连续工作流程模式得到了扩展和验证。 Brodeur和同事在五个临床推理实验(差别诊断生成、展示推理、分辨差异、概率推理、管理推理)的基线上测试了数百名医生的先进模型,这些模型由专家医生用经过验证的心理计量法裁定,并以一个现实世界的紧急部门试验作为补充,比较一个高等学术中心的人类和模型第二意见(Brodeur等人,2026年)。 该模型与医生在不确定情况下基于文本的分类和推理的性能相匹配或超过其性能,但与其仅限文本输入和缺乏床边多式联运提示相限制(Brodeur等人,2026年)。 这一界限同样适用于任何评价,包括推动这一审查的评价,即仅从案文中进行推理。

blocks.en: Rao and colleagues expose the vulnerability that sits underneath such aggregate performance. Evaluating 21 frontier models across identical sequential workflow stages on 29 standardised vignettes, they found performance strongest at final diagnosis and management and weakest at early diagnostic reasoning and differential generation, and characterised a consistent failure mode of premature diagnostic closure: convergence on a single diagnosis when uncertainty and competing hypotheses should have been sustained ( Rao et al., 2026 ) . High accuracy on final diagnostic targets therefore masks intermediate reasoning failure, which is the clearest available empirical argument for scoring trajectories rather than endpoints.
blocks.zh: Rao和同事揭露了这种总体业绩之下的脆弱性。 在29个标准化工作流程中,对21个相同顺序工作流程阶段的前沿模型进行评估,发现在最后诊断和管理中表现最强,在早期诊断推理和差异生成中表现最弱,并定性为不成熟诊断关闭的一贯失败模式:当不确定性和相互竞争的假设应当维持下去时,在单一诊断上趋同(Rao等人,2026年)。 因此,最终诊断目标的高度准确性掩盖了中间推理失败,而中间推理失败是评分轨迹而不是终点的最明确的经验论据。

blocks.en: To move beyond final-outcome matching and capture these intermediate reasoning errors, recent work has pivoted toward highly structured, expert-authored rubrics. Ismail and colleagues addressed the limitation of unweighted checklists by introducing five deliberately difficult clinician-authored scenarios, each accompanied by an atomic, weighted, mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive rubric comprising 25 to 62 criteria per task (184 criteria in total) ( Ismail et al., 2026 ) . Their controlled comparison of frontier language models revealed what they term an inversion of clinical priority: while models scored between 80% and 90% on low-stakes, simple checklist items, they satisfied critical, safety-essential (weight-5) criteria at rates of only 32.4% to 41.7%, and over half of these critical criteria were met by no model ( Ismail et al., 2026 ) . This indicates that evaluations which ignore clinical risk weightings fail to detect dangerous clinical omissions.
blocks.zh: 为了超越最终结果的匹配和捕捉这些中间推理错误,最近的工作向高度结构化的、由专家撰写的标题发展。 伊斯梅尔和同事们讨论了未加权核对表的限制问题,提出了5个故意困难的临床医生撰写的假设,每个假设都附有一个原子、加权、相互排斥和集体详尽的条目,每个任务包括25至62个标准(共计184个标准)(伊斯梅尔等人,2026年)。 他们对前沿语言模型的控制性比较揭示了他们所谓的临床优先级的颠倒:虽然模型在低摄取量、简单的核对表项目上得分在80%至90%之间,但他们满足了关键、安全的必要(重量-5)标准,其比率仅为32.4%至41.7%,而且超过一半的关键标准没有模型得到满足(Ismail等人,2026年)。 这表明,无视临床风险加权的评价未能发现危险的临床遗漏。

blocks.en: MedThink-Bench addresses scalability of trajectory scoring. Comprising 500 complex medical question and answer pairs across ten domains annotated with expert-crafted step-by-step rationales, it scores intermediate “scoring points” rather than final answers, and its LLM-w-Ref evaluation framework achieves strong correlation with expert clinician judgement ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Read alongside the judge-reliability audit discussed below ( Norman et al., 2026 ) , this correlation should be treated as promising rather than settled, since correlation with experts is not the same as chance-corrected agreement.
blocks.zh: MedThink-Bench处理轨迹积分的可伸缩性. 它由500个复杂的医疗问答组合组成,涉及10个领域,并附有由专家精心设计的逐步理由,它得分是中间“得分”,而不是最后的答案,其LLM-w-Ref评价框架与专家临床医生的判断(周等人,2026年)有着很强的相关性。 与下文讨论的法官-可靠性审计(Norman等人,2026年)一并阅读,这种关联应被看作是有希望的,而不是解决的,因为与专家的关联与偶然纠正的协议不同。

blocks.en: DR.BENCH is helpful mainly as a warning. It packages six tasks under the heading of diagnostic reasoning, but scores them using generation metrics such as ROUGE-L and F1 ( Gao et al., 2023 ) . That means it should be read mainly as a benchmark of task performance under those metrics, not as a strong measure of reasoning quality in a broader sense. In this review, it is therefore more useful as a reminder not to take benchmark labels at face value than as a model for a reasoning rubric. OLAPH, which improves and evaluates factuality in biomedical long-form question answering, sits adjacent to this strand and is noted here as the main clinical entry point into the long-form factuality literature discussed below ( Jeong et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 医生 BENCH主要是作为警告的帮助. 它在诊断推理标题下包了6项任务,但使用ROUGE-L和F1(Gao等人,2023年)等生成度量衡来评分. 这意味着它应主要被理解为这些衡量标准下的任务业绩基准,而不是广义推理质量的有力衡量标准。 因此,在本次审查中,比起作为推理题材的模型,提醒不要把基准标签放在面值上更有用。 OLAPH在生物医学长式答题中改进并评价了事实性,它紧挨着这一链条,在此被指为以下讨论的长式事实性文献的主要临床切入点(Jeong等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Three recent additions to this strand bear directly on the gaps this review identifies, and each partially fills one of them. Du and colleagues operationalise diagnostic uncertainty preservation as a scoreable property: across 1,200 clinical documents annotated with over nine thousand propositions on a five-level uncertainty scale, they find that models preserve the original diagnostic uncertainty level in under half of cases, collapsing “possible” findings into definite ones or hedging definite findings into vague ones ( Du et al., 2026 ) . This is the first tool in the checked sources that treats preservation of expressed diagnostic uncertainty as a measurable dimension rather than a desideratum, and its five-level taxonomy is directly reusable for rubric item design. MamaBench does analogous work for counterfactual reasoning: it constructs matched counterfactual pairs of clinical narratives in maternal and child health (434 narratives forming 217 pairs) in which a single discriminative clinical parameter changes the correct diagnosis, and measures whether models change their answer accordingly, reporting a “Bias Trap Rate” and identifying a characteristic failure mode of diagnostic fixation on the unperturbed presentation ( Adewuyi et al., 2026 ) . It is narrow in specialty and works on paired vignettes rather than longitudinal free text, but it demonstrates that counterfactual clinical robustness can be operationalised as a scored quantity. Third, Oukelmoun and colleagues treat omission detection in LLM-generated medical summaries as a problem distinct from hallucination detection, with a dedicated detection method ( Oukelmoun et al., 2025 ) ; this is the only paper found in the checked sources that separates the two failure modes explicitly in clinical text, and a natural baseline for any rubric-based completeness metric. A working paper by Meincke and colleagues, which frames diagnosis in a high-fidelity patient simulation as a partially observable sequential decision problem and reports accuracy conditional on the model’s stated confidence, provides rare empirical calibration data in a clinically realistic setting, though it is not yet peer-reviewed and is cited here with that caveat ( Meincke et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 这一方面最近增加了三个部分,这直接关系到本审查查明的差距,每个部分弥补了其中的一个差距。 杜和同事将诊断不确定性保全作为可评财产运作:在1,200份临床文件中,在五级不确定性尺度上附加了9,000多项建议,他们发现模型在不到一半的病例中保留了最初的诊断不确定性水平,将“可能”的发现折成明确的结论,或将确定的结论套入模糊的结论(Du等人,2026年)。 这是被检查来源中第一个将保留表达的诊断不确定性视为可计量维度而非底端的工具,其五级分类学可直接用于路标项目设计. Mama Bench为反事实推理做了类似的工作:它构建了妇幼健康临床叙事对应的反事实对(434个叙事组成217对),其中单一的歧视性临床参数改变正确的诊断,并衡量模型是否相应改变答案,报告“Bias陷阱率”并在未扰动的演示上确定诊断固定的特征故障模式(Adewuyi等人,2026年)。 它在特长上狭小,在配对的阴道上工作,而不是纵向自由文字,但它表明反事实临床稳健性可以作为分数操作. 第三,Oukelmoun和同事将LLM生成的医学摘要中的遗漏检测视为不同于幻觉检测的问题,并采用专门的检测方法(Oukelmoun等人,2025年);这是在被检查来源中发现的唯一一张在临床文本中明确区分两种故障模式的论文,以及任何基于粗略的完整度量的自然基线。 Meincke和同事编写的一份工作文件将高可靠性病人模拟中的诊断定为部分可观察的顺序决定问题,并报告准确性,条件是模型已表明的信心。 这份工作文件在临床现实环境下提供了罕见的经验校准数据,尽管尚未经过同行评审,在此引证这一警告(Meincke等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation methodology as a separate literature
blocks.zh: 6. 评价方法作为单独文献

blocks.en: A third body of work sits alongside the medical education and clinical benchmark strands: general-domain research on how to score long-form generation reliably. This literature is not clinical, but it is methodologically decisive for any clinical rubric, because it determines whether that rubric can be applied at scale.
blocks.zh: 第三套工作与医学教育和临床基准线并列:关于如何可靠地评分长体一代的一般领域研究。 这种文献并非临床文献,但对于任何临床题材而言,在方法上都是决定性的,因为它决定了该题材是否可以在规模上应用.

blocks.en: Its genealogy is worth a sentence, because it explains why the field converged on checklists. The first generation of LLM-as-judge evaluation used holistic judgements; G-Eval’s chain-of-thought scoring ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and the MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena validity study ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) are the founding examples. The move to explicit, fine-grained criteria came with Prometheus ( Kim et al., 2024 ) and FLASK ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , which decompose judgement into named skills or rubric dimensions. In parallel, factuality evaluation developed a decompose-search-verify pipeline (FActScore ( Min et al., 2023 ) , VeriScore ( Song et al., 2024 ) and SAFE ( Wei et al., 2024 ) ) which scores the precision of atomic claims but is structurally silent on whether a response contains the claims it should have contained. Both lineages feed directly into the tools a clinical reasoning rubric must rely on.
blocks.zh: 它的家族学值得一提,因为它解释了为什么这个字段在核对表上汇合. 第一代LLM-as-judge评价采用整体判断;G-Eval的思维链评分(Liu等人,2023年)和MT-Bench和Chatbot Arena有效性研究(Zheng等人,2023年)是创始例子. 向明晰,精细的标码的移动是普罗米修斯(Kim等人,2024年)和FLASK(Ye等人,2024年),它们将判断分解为命名技能或粗略维度. 与此同时,事实评价开发了分解-搜索-核查管道(FActScore(Min等人,2023年),VeriScore) (Song et al., 2024)和SAFE(Wei et al., 2024))对原子主张的精确度进行评分,但对答复中是否包含它应该包含的主张却在结构上保持沉默. 两个线条都直接输入工具 一个临床推理标语必须依赖。

blocks.en: Two findings from the checklist literature are directly consequential. Lee and colleagues (CheckEval) show that LLM-as-judge unreliability derives substantially from combining subjective criteria with Likert-scale scoring; decomposing evaluation into binary checklist questions raised average inter-evaluator agreement across twelve judge models by 0.45 and reduced score variance, while retaining strong correlation with human judgement ( Lee et al., 2025 ) . One qualification should be attached to that figure: it is raw agreement, not chance-corrected reliability. A recent large-scale audit of twenty-one judge models across roughly half a million judgements found that raw agreement systematically overstates chance-corrected kappa by 33 to 41 percentage points, that judge rankings shift substantially across benchmarks, and that high test-retest consistency can coexist with severe position bias ( Norman et al., 2026 ) . This does not invalidate the CheckEval result, but it does mean that any rubric built on binary items and LLM judges, including the one motivating this review, must report chance-corrected agreement and test for positional and formatting biases, rather than treating raw agreement as evidence of judge trustworthiness.
blocks.zh: 核对表文献得出的两个结论是直接结果。 Lee和同事(CheckEval)表明,LLM-as-judge不可靠在很大程度上来自将主观标准与Ilikrt-scale评分相结合;将评价分解为二进制清单问题,使12个评分模型的平均评价者之间达成一致0.45,并减少了评分差异,同时保持了与人类判断的强烈相关性(Lee等人,2025年)。 这一数字应附加一项限定条件:这是原始协议,而不是偶然纠正的可靠性。 最近对大约50万份判决中的21个法官模型进行了大规模审计,发现原始协议系统地高报了33至41个百分点的概率校正卡帕,法官的排名在基准之间发生了很大变化,高水平的测试-测试一致性可以与严重的职位偏差共存(Norman等人,2026年)。 这并不意味着CheckEval结果无效,但确实意味着任何基于二进制项目和LLM评委,包括推动本次审查的评委,必须报告偶然修正的协议,并测试位置和格式上的偏差,而不是将原始协议作为法官可信度的证据。

blocks.en: The second consequential finding comes from Ruan and colleagues (ExpertLongBench and the CLEAR framework), who evaluate expert-level long-form generation across eleven tasks in nine domains including medicine, scoring outputs against expert-authored structured checklists. They found that models covered over two-thirds of expert-rubric checklist items on average, while the best-performing model achieved an overall task F1 of only 33.4, and that checklist coverage was only weakly correlated with output accuracy ( Ruan et al., 2025 ) . Their conclusion, that high coverage can make incorrect output appear expert-aligned, is the central methodological warning for clinical rubric design.
blocks.zh: 第二个结果来自Ruan和同事(专家Long Bench和CLEAR框架),他们评价了包括医学在内的九个领域的11项任务中专家一级的长式生成,对照专家编写的结构化清单对产出进行评分。 他们发现,模型平均涵盖超过三分之二的专家-鲁布清单项目,而最佳模型只完成了33.4的总任务F1,而且清单的涵盖范围与产出的准确性密切相关(Ruan等人,2025年)。 他们的结论,即高覆盖率可以使不正确的产出看起来与专家一致,是临床主题设计方法的核心警告。

blocks.en: A convergent third strand concerns claim importance and completeness. Jafari and colleagues argue that existing factuality evaluation is overwhelmingly precision-oriented (responses are decomposed into atomic claims and each is verified), which says nothing about whether the response covers the facts it should have included; they propose measuring precision and recall jointly, weighting reference facts by relevance and salience, and find that current models perform markedly better on precision than recall ( Jafari et al., 2026 ) . Chen and colleagues (GAMUT) reach a convergent conclusion from a different direction with a two-level meta-rubric: a structured expert-authored representation that encodes content organisation and importance tiers, mechanically compiled to a flat checklist of binary, LLM-gradable items, with contradiction penalised more heavily than omission ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Across fourteen frontier models on their benchmark, they report that omission, rather than fabrication, is the dominant failure mode in long-form generation, accounting for roughly two-thirds of failures in the weakest models and over a quarter even in the strongest ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . One qualification is required and is stated plainly: GAMUT is a general-domain, multimodal benchmark built on consumer imagery, in which medical content amounts to roughly one percent of the dataset and consists of consumer-facing factual lookups rather than clinical reasoning ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Its omission-dominance finding is therefore adopted here as a general-domain result extrapolated to the clinical case, not as clinical evidence. The extrapolation is nonetheless defensible, because the same signature is already visible inside the clinical literature: MedR-Bench reports high step-level accuracy alongside omissions at critical reasoning steps ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) , and dedicated clinical omission-detection work confirms that omission is a distinct and prevalent failure mode in medical summarisation ( Oukelmoun et al., 2025 ) . Wanner and colleagues (VITAL) independently show that treating all claims as equally important obscures errors in key information ( Wanner et al., 2025 ) . The clinical analogue is obvious: the unmentioned red-flag diagnosis or unacknowledged contraindication is a recognised source of harm.
blocks.zh: 第三个共同点涉及声称的重要性和完整性。 贾法里和同事认为,现有的事实评价绝大多数是精准的(答复被分解为原子权利主张,而且每个答复都经过核实),这些答复对答复是否涵盖它应该包括的事实没有说明;他们建议用相关性和显著性来衡量参考事实,共同衡量和召回,发现目前的模型在精准性方面明显优于召回(贾法里等人,2026年)。 陈和同事(GAMUT)从一个不同方向得出一个与两级元Rubric不同的趋同结论:一种结构化的专家作者代表,将内容组织和重要性层次编码,机械汇编成二进制,LLM可分级的项目的平面清单,相互矛盾的处罚比遗漏更为严重(Chen等人,2026年)。 在14个前沿模型的基准上,它们报告说,遗漏而不是捏造是长型模型中的主要失败模式,占最弱型模型的大约三分之二,甚至超过四分之一(Chen等人,2026年)。 需要一种资格,并明确指出: GAMUT是一个基于消费者图像的通用领域、多式联运基准,其中医疗内容约占数据集的1%,由消费者面对的事实观察而不是临床推理组成(Chen等人,2026年)。 因此,此处采用其忽略式调查结论作为临床案例推断的一般领域结果,而不是临床证据。 然而,推断是站不住脚的,因为临床文献中已经可以看到同样的签名: Medr-Bench报告说,在关键的推理步骤(邱等人,2025年)中,高阶精确度和遗漏(Quu等人,2025年),以及专门的临床遗漏检测工作证实,遗漏是医学总结中一个明显和普遍的失败模式(Oukelmoun等人,2025年)。 Wanner和同事(VITAL)独立表明,将所有索赔作为同样重要的索赔处理,掩盖了关键信息中的错误(Wanner等人,2025年)。 临床类比是显而易见的:未提及的红旗诊断或未承认的禁忌是公认的伤害源。

blocks.en:
Four design commitments inform the proposed instrument.
These are design recommendations rather than implemented
or validated features. First, we propose defining rubric dimensions with human-facing anchors for construct clarity and compiling them into binary items for automated scoring, a separation supported by CheckEval and GAMUT’s meta-rubric architecture ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Second, completeness and correctness are scored as separate quantities rather than combined into a single quality judgement, since high coverage can mask error ( Ruan et al., 2025 ; Jafari et al., 2026 ) ; on this point the approach deliberately departs from GAMUT, which folds both into one asymmetrically weighted score ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Third, reference facts are converted into case-specific required, optional and prohibited items with pre-specified clinical-importance weights, so that omission of a safety-critical item is not equivalent to omission of a minor detail; this can be operationalised with an existing framework such as AutoRubric, which supports weighted criteria, negative weights for unsafe content, ensemble judging, and psychometric reliability reporting ( Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) , and has a clinical precedent in HealthBench’s negatively weighted harm criteria ( Arora et al., 2025 ) . Fourth, in light of the judge-reliability audit, all automated scoring should report chance-corrected agreement statistics and position-bias checks, not raw agreement alone ( Norman et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
拟议的文书有四项设计承诺。
这些是设计建议而不是执行
或经验证的特性。 首先,我们提议用人造锚来定义标点,以构建清晰度,并将其汇编成二进制项目,用于自动评分,这种分离由CheckEval和GAMUT的元Rubric架构支持(Lee等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年)。 第二,完整性和正确性被评为单独数量,而不是合并为单一的质量判断,因为高覆盖率可以掩盖错误(Ruan等人,2025年;Jafari等人,2026年);在这一点上,该方法有意偏离GAMUT, 两者均折叠成一个不对称加权分(Chen等人,2026年)。 第三,参考事实被转换成有特定病例要求的、可选的和有预先规定的临床重要性权重的违禁物品,因此,略去安全关键物品并不等于略微细节的遗漏;这可以用AutoRubric等现有框架来操作,该框架支持加权标准、不安全内容的负加权、共同判断以及心理计量可靠性报告(Rao和Callison-Burch, 2026年),并在Health Bench的负加权损害标准中有一个临床先例(Arora等人, 2025年)。 第四,鉴于法官-可靠性审计,所有自动评分应报告机会校正的协议统计数据和职位-偏见检查,而不只是原始协议(Norman等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Two limitations of this literature should be stated plainly. None of these frameworks evaluates whether stated reasoning caused the output, so the faithfulness gap identified below is not resolved by methodological refinement alone. And none accommodates longitudinal, multi-document input in which later records legitimately supersede earlier ones, a defining feature of serial clinical records. This limitation is particularly relevant to longitudinal clinical
records, where chronological ordering and the interpretation of later
information are integral to the meaning of a clinical narrative.
A temporal component of a rubric should therefore test whether
models preserve the order and status of clinically relevant events,
including whether later documentation supersedes earlier information.
blocks.zh:
应明确阐述这一文献的两个局限性。 这些框架都没有评价说明的推理是否促成了产出,因此,下文确定的忠诚差距不能仅靠方法上的改进来解决。 没有一个能容纳纵向的,多文件的输入,其中后期的记录可以合法地取代早期的记录,这是系列临床记录的决定性特征。 这一限制与纵向临床特别相关
记录,按时间顺序排列和解释
信息是临床叙述意义的组成部分。
因此,一个标题的时间部分应检验:
模型保持临床相关事件的顺序和状态,
包括以后的文件是否取代以前的信息。

blocks.en: 7 What is covered, what is partially covered, and what is missing
blocks.zh: 页:1 涵盖的内容、部分涵盖的内容和缺失的内容

blocks.en: Looking across the strands, the overall picture is more textured than a simple covered/uncovered division, and Table 1 summarises it. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are relatively well covered, at least in part ( Baker et al., 2015 ; Schaye et al., 2022 ; Thammasitboon et al., 2018 ; Lubarsky et al., 2013 ; Arora et al., 2025 ) . Temporal reasoning is directly measured mainly by TIMER-Eval, with the supersession problem still open ( Cui et al., 2025 ) . Calibrated uncertainty and counterfactual reasoning are better described as emerging: each now has at least one dedicated clinical operationalisation ( Du et al., 2026 ; Adewuyi et al., 2026 ) , but neither has a reusable rubric for longitudinal free-text outputs, and both existing tools work on static or paired vignettes rather than serial records. Factual completeness has moved from invisible to well-theorised in the general domain ( Jafari et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wanner et al., 2025 ) , with early clinical instantiations ( Oukelmoun et al., 2025 ) . Reasoning faithfulness remains the most weakly covered dimension, but the honest statement of that gap has changed, as follows.
blocks.zh: 纵观各行各业,总体情况比简单的覆盖/未覆盖的划分更有条理,表1对此作了总结。 问题表述和差异或管理推理的涵盖范围相对较广,至少部分(Baker等人,2015年;Schaye等人,2022年;Thammasitboon等人,2018年;Lubarsky等人,2013年;Arora等人,2025年)。 时间推理主要由TIER-Eval直接测量,超级会话问题仍未解决(Cui等人,2025年). 校准的不确定性和反事实推理被更好地描述为正在出现:现在每个都至少有一个专用的临床操作(Du等人,2026年;Adewuyi等人,2026年),但都没有纵向自由文本输出的可重复使用的标题,现有的工具都用于静态或配对的维格内特而不是序列记录. 事实完整性已经从隐形到一般领域的理论完善(Jafari等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Wanner等人,2025年),早期临床即时分析。 (Oukelmoun等人,2025年). 理性的忠诚仍然是涵盖最薄弱的方面,但关于这一差距的诚实声明已经改变如下。

blocks.zh: 表1:现有仪器和基准对6个临床理由的涵盖范围。

blocks.en: 8 Reasoning faithfulness
blocks.zh: 8 理性的忠诚

blocks.en: Reasoning faithfulness is the clearest gap, but it is no longer an empty one. The chain-of-thought literature shows that model explanations can be unfaithful to the processes that produce answers: Turpin and colleagues demonstrated that answers can be steered by biasing features the model never mentions in its explanation ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) , and Arcuschin and colleagues extended this to realistic, unbiased prompts, documenting implicit post-hoc rationalisation at rates that vary widely across production models ( Arcuschin et al., 2025 ) . A rationale that sounds coherent is therefore not necessarily a faithful account of how the output was generated. This matters because the medical education tools above were not designed to detect that problem ( Baker et al., 2015 ; Schaye et al., 2022 ; Thammasitboon et al., 2018 ; Lubarsky et al., 2013 ) . They generally assume that the explanation is part of the reasoning performance itself, whereas in the LLM setting that assumption needs to be tested rather than simply accepted.
blocks.zh: 理性的忠诚是最明显的差距,但它不再是空的。 思考链的文献表明,模型解释可能对产生答案的流程不忠:图尔平和同事证明,答案可以通过模型解释中从未提及的偏差特征来引导(图尔平等人,2023年),而阿尔库斯钦和同事将这一点扩展至现实的,没有偏见的提示,记录了隐含的后危险理性化,其速度因生产模式的不同而大不相同(阿尔库斯钦等人,2025年). 因此,听起来一致的理由并不一定是产出产生方式的忠实叙述。 这一点很重要,因为上面的医疗教育工具并非旨在发现这一问题(Baker等人,2015年;Schaye等人,2022年;Thammasitboon等人,2018年;Lubarsky等人,2013年)。 他们一般认为,解释是推理性能本身的一部分,而在LLM设定中,这种假设需要测试而不是简单地接受.

blocks.en: There is now at least one direct clinical instantiation of that test. Afolabi and colleagues run a causal-ablation probe on medical question answering: reasoning steps are redacted one at a time, and a step is counted as causal only if its removal changes the model’s prediction. They find that only around ten percent of chain-of-thought steps are individually causal, and that removing steps improved predictions about as often as it harmed them, a pattern consistent with post-hoc rationalisation rather than load-bearing reasoning ( Afolabi et al., 2026 ) . This study is the closest existing partial solution to the faithfulness gap, and its redact-and-observe design is a template that a clinical reasoning rubric can adapt. Its limitations also delimit what remains open: it is a workshop-track study of three closed-source models on multiple-choice questions, and single-step redaction cannot distinguish an unnecessary step from one that is redundant with retained content ( Afolabi et al., 2026 ) . No clinical work identified in this review performs causal mediation on internal representations or measures divergence between latent and verbalised reasoning; that sub-literature exists only in general-domain interpretability research. The gap is therefore precisely stated: not the absence of faithfulness testing in medicine, but the absence of a rubric-integrated, free-text, longitudinal version of it.
blocks.zh: 现在至少有一次直接的临床即时测试。 Afolabi和同事对医疗问题回答进行因果分析:推理步骤一次修改一次,一个步骤只有在其删除改变模型预测时才算成因果。 他们发现,只有大约10%的思维链步骤是个别的因果,而去除这些步骤后,对伤害频率的预测也有所改进,这种模式符合事后理性而不是负载推理(Afolabi等人,2026年)。 本研究是目前最接近于忠实差距的部分解决方案,其编辑-观察设计是临床推理题材可以适应的模板. 它的局限性也划定了仍然开放的内容:它是对三个多个选择问题的封闭源代码模型的研讨会轨道研究,单步编辑不能区分不必要的步骤和保留内容的多余步骤(Afolabi等人,2026年)。 本审查中确定的任何临床工作都没有就内部表述或潜在推理和口头推理之间的措施差异进行因果调解;这种次文学只在一般领域解释性研究中存在。 因此,这一差距是准确表述的:不是在医学中缺乏忠诚度测试,而是缺乏一个鲁语集成,自由文字,纵向版本.

blocks.en: Jacovi and Goldberg provide the conceptual grounding here, defining faithfulness as the extent to which an explanation accurately reflects the reasoning process actually underlying an output, and arguing against a binary conception in favour of a graded one, on the grounds that a strict pass/fail standard is unrealistic and of limited practical use ( Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ) . That graded framing is the appropriate one for a rubric: faithfulness is treated as a scored dimension, assessed through perturbation and counterfactual probing that extends the causal-ablation design from multiple-choice answers to free-text differential generation, rather than certified as a binary property. One structural point deserves emphasis: faithfulness cannot be folded into the completeness or correctness axes, because a model can be complete and correct while its stated reasoning did not cause its answer. Checklist architectures verify what is stated, not why it was stated, so faithfulness requires interventional measurement by construction.
blocks.zh: Jacovi和Goldberg提供了这里的概念基础,将忠诚定义为一个解释准确反映一个产出实际背后的推理过程的程度,并基于严格的通过/失败标准不切实际且实用性有限(Jacovi和Goldberg,2020年)的理由,反对有利于分级的二进制概念。 这种分级的设定是适合一个标题的设定:忠诚被视作一个得分的维度,通过扰动和反事实检验来评估,从而将因果推断设计从多选择答案延伸至自由文本差异生成,而不是认证为二进制属性. 一个结构点值得强调:忠诚不能折叠成完整或正确轴,因为一个模型可以完整和正确,而其陈述的推理并没有引起答案. 核对表架构验证的是所陈述的,而不是为何所陈述的,所以忠诚度需要建筑的干预测量.

blocks.en: 9 Counterfactual reasoning
blocks.zh: 9 反事实推理

blocks.en: Counterfactual reasoning is the second main gap, now partially narrowed. MamaBench demonstrates that counterfactual clinical robustness can be scored, and its paired-perturbation design and Bias Trap Rate metric are directly transferable, but it is confined to one specialty and to short paired vignettes ( Adewuyi et al., 2026 ) . The checked sources still do not provide a rubric for scoring counterfactual clinical reasoning in longitudinal free-text outputs, where the perturbation of interest may be a changed result three documents back rather than a swapped parameter in a single vignette. The safer conclusion is therefore not that there is no related work, but that there is a transferable measurement design and no reusable tool for this specific task.
blocks.zh: 反事实推理是第二个主要漏洞,现在部分缩小. Mama Bench证明反事实临床强健性可以得分,其配对-扰动设计和Bias Trap rate 度量衡可以直接转移,但仅限于一种特产和短配对的阴茎(Adewuyi等人,2026年). 被检查的来源仍然没有为纵向自由文本输出中的反事实临床推理提供标语,其中对兴趣的扰动可能是改变的结果,返回三个文件,而不是一个单维格涅特的互换参数. 因此,比较安全的结论不是说没有相关工作,而是说有可转移的测量设计,没有可用于这一具体任务的工具。

blocks.en: 10 Calibrated uncertainty
blocks.zh: 10 校准的不确定性

blocks.en: Calibrated uncertainty follows the same pattern. Uncertainty preservation in clinical text is now measurable, and the finding that models preserve the source’s diagnostic uncertainty level in under half of cases is itself a motivating result for treating this as a first-class rubric dimension ( Du et al., 2026 ) . Early calibration data from simulated sequential diagnosis suggest that stated confidence does carry signal in clinically realistic settings ( Meincke et al., 2026 ) . The characteristic failure mode is corroborated from two independent directions. Rao and colleagues document models collapsing complex differentials into premature diagnostic closure when competing possibilities are present ( Rao et al., 2026 ) , and McCoy and colleagues show, against expert-panel distributions, a strong bias toward extreme SCT responses and near-avoidance of neutral ratings, evidence of an inability to make subtle probabilistic adjustments on new information ( McCoy et al., 2025 ) . What is still missing is the combination that longitudinal records require: calibration assessed over a case in which the appropriate uncertainty level itself changes as records accumulate.
blocks.zh: 校准的不确定性遵循同样的模式。 临床文本中的不确定性保存现在可以衡量,而模型在不到一半的病例中保持来源诊断不确定性的发现本身就是一个将它作为头等值处理的动力结果(Du等人,2026年)。 模拟顺序诊断的早期校准数据表明,在临床现实环境下,所声明的置信性确实带有信号(Mencke等人,2026年)。 特征故障模式从两个独立方向得到证实. Rao和同事记录了一些模型,这些模型在存在相互竞争的可能性时,将复杂的差解成不成熟的诊断关闭(Rao等人,2026年),而McCoy和同事则显示,他们反对专家小组的分布,强烈偏向于极端SCT反应,几乎避免了中性评级,这表明无法对新信息作出微妙的概率调整(McCoy等人,2025年)。 仍然缺少的是纵向记录需要的组合:对适当不确定性水平本身随着记录积累而发生变化的情况进行校准。

blocks.en: 11 Factual completeness
blocks.zh: 11 事实完整性

blocks.en: Whereas most benchmarks are precision-oriented and ask whether stated claims are correct ( Min et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) , the convergent findings of Jafari, GAMUT, and VITAL indicate that omission of required content is the more common and, clinically, the more dangerous failure ( Jafari et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wanner et al., 2025 ) . This omission dominance has now received clinical confirmation. Ismail and colleagues showed that evaluating models using flat checklists or unweighted summaries masks critical clinical omissions: under a clinician-authored, weighted rubric, models achieved high coverage on low-stakes administrative or communication criteria while frequently omitting high-stakes, safety-critical actions such as emergency escalation or contraindicated-treatment warnings ( Ismail et al., 2026 ) . This inversion of clinical priority indicates that completeness cannot be scored as a simple proportion of covered items; safety-critical omissions must act as non-compensable score caps. Zhou and colleagues add that checking intermediate step-level scoring points, rather than final-answer matching, is necessary to detect models that bypass critical logical steps ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 虽然大多数基准是精准的,并询问所陈述的主张是否正确(Min等人,2023年;Song等人,2024年;Wei等人,2024年),但Jafari、GAMUT和VITAL的趋同结论表明,遗漏所需内容更为常见,在临床上,更危险的失败(Jafari等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Wanner等人,2025年)。 这种疏忽的主导地位现已得到临床证实。 伊斯梅尔和同事们表明,使用统一核对表或未加权摘要评估模型掩盖了关键的临床遗漏:在临床医生授权的加权标题下,模型在低摄取的行政或通信标准上实现了高覆盖率,同时经常省略高摄取、安全关键行动,如紧急升级或禁用治疗警告(Ismail等人,2026年)。 这种临床优先权的颠倒表明,完整性不能作为被覆盖物品的简单比例来评分;安全关键遗漏必须作为不可补偿的分数上限。 周和同事补充说,检查中间级的积分,而不是最终的答案匹配,对于检测绕过关键逻辑步骤的模型是必要的(周和等人,2026年).

blocks.en: 12 What needs to be combined
blocks.zh: 第12条 需要结合的内容

blocks.en: The practical implication is fairly modest. An evaluation programme for clinical reasoning over serial records does not need to throw away existing tools; it needs to use them carefully and only for the parts they actually measure. R-IDEA provides a starting point for assessing written problem representation and differential reasoning, informed by the study-specific reliability findings for IDEA and Revised-IDEA ( Baker et al., 2015 ; Schaye et al., 2022 ) . Its reliability for assessing LLM outputs remains to be established. TIMER-Eval is the clearest starting point for assessing temporal reasoning over serial records, extended to test supersession rather than only chronology ( Cui et al., 2025 ) . Uncertainty-preservation taxonomies ( Du et al., 2026 ) and counterfactual pairing designs ( Adewuyi et al., 2026 ) supply measurement patterns for two dimensions that previously had none, and the causal-ablation paradigm supplies one for faithfulness ( Afolabi et al., 2026 ) . The rest of the rubric then needs to join the strands together: use the medical education literature to keep the rubric clinically meaningful, use the LLM benchmark literature for setting-specific measurement designs, and use the evaluation-methodology literature to make the whole thing psychometrically defensible at scale, through binary compilation for reliability ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , separated completeness and correctness ( Ruan et al., 2025 ; Jafari et al., 2026 ) , importance weighting with safety caps ( Arora et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Wanner et al., 2025 ; Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) , order-consistency for the temporal axis, and chance-corrected reliability reporting throughout ( Norman et al., 2026 ) . Beyond that, genuine design work remains for the three dimensions where existing tools supply patterns but not instruments: calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning, and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records.
blocks.zh: 实际影响不大。 对序列记录进行临床推理的评价方案不需要放弃现有的工具;它需要仔细使用这些工具,并且只用于它们实际测量的部分. R-IDEA为评估书面问题表述和差异推理提供了一个起点,其中参考了IDEA和Review-IDEA的具体研究可靠性调查结果(Baker等人,2015年;Schaye等人,2022年)。 其评估LLM产出的可靠性仍有待确定。 TimeR-Eval是评估时间推理相对于序列记录的最明确的起点,延伸至测试超会话,而不仅仅是时间顺序(Cui等人,2025年)。 不确定-保全分类法(Du等人,2026年)和反事实配对设计法(Adewuyi等人,2026年)为以前没有的两维提供测量模式,因果-推断范式为忠诚提供一种(Afolabi等人,2026年). 其余部分则需要合并到一起来:利用医学教育文献来保持标题临床意义,利用LLM基准文献来设定特定测量设计,并利用评价方法文献通过可靠性二进制汇编(Lee等人,2025年),分离完整性和正确性(Ruan等人,2025年;Jafari等人,2026年),安全帽加权的重要性(Arora等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年;Wanner等人,2025年;Rao和Callison-Burch,2026年),时间轴的顺序一致性,以及整个概率校正可靠性报告(Norman等人,2026年)。 除此之外,真正的设计工作仍然是针对现有工具提供模式而非工具的三个方面:校准不确定性、反事实推理和对纵向自由文本记录的忠诚。

blocks.en: Specifically, the integration draws on McCoy and colleagues’ scaled concordance paradigm for structured judgement under uncertainty ( McCoy et al., 2025 ) , Brodeur and colleagues’ multi-stage workflow design for mapping reasoning trajectories sequentially ( Brodeur et al., 2026 ) , Rao and colleagues’ premature-closure finding as the motivating failure mode for the differential axis ( Rao et al., 2026 ) , and Ismail and colleagues’ atomic weighted rubrics as the model for safety-critical prioritisation ( Ismail et al., 2026 ) . Methodologically, the rubric separates completeness from correctness ( Ruan et al., 2025 ; Jafari et al., 2026 ) , applies order-consistency to the temporal axis, and reports chance-corrected reliability throughout ( Norman et al., 2026 ) . Binary compilation and case-specific importance weighting remain planned build steps rather than implemented features ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , as does the specification of judge models, repeated runs, option-order randomisation, and acceptance thresholds. Automated grading at high agreement is plausible on the evidence of MedThink-Bench and Ismail and colleagues ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Ismail et al., 2026 ) , but that evidence is correlational and must be re-established with chance-corrected statistics on any new instrument. This paper reports the design rationale for such an instrument, not a validated instrument.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,这种整合利用了McCoy和同事在不确定性下结构化判断的大规模一致性模式(McCoy等人,2025年),Brodeur和同事的绘制推理轨迹的多阶段工作流程设计相继进行(Brodeur等人,2026年),Rao和同事的过早关闭发现是差分轴(Rao等人,2026年)的激励失败模式,以及伊斯梅尔和同事的原子加权面作为安全关键排序的模式(Ismail等人,2026年)。 在方法上,标题将完整性与正确性区分开来(Ruan等人,2025年;Jafari等人,2026年),对时间轴适用顺序一致性,并报告整个过程中偶然纠正的可靠性(Norman等人,2026年)。 二进制汇编和具体案件重要性权重仍然是计划中的建设步骤,而不是执行的特征(Lee等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年),法官模型的规格、重复运行、选择顺序随机化和接受阈值也是如此。 根据MedThink-Bench和Ismail及其同事的证据(周等人,2026年;Ismail等人,2026年),高度一致的自动分级是可信的,但这种证据是相互关联的,必须重新确立,并有关于任何新文书的概率校正统计数据。 本文件报告了这种文书的设计理由,而不是经过验证的文书。

blocks.en: 13 Limitations of this review
blocks.zh: 13. 本次审查的限制

blocks.en: Four limitations should be stated. First, screening and synthesis were performed by a single reviewer without dual screening or a formal flow diagram, so the review is a structured narrative map rather than a PRISMA-compliant scoping review. Second, the LLM evaluation literature moves largely through preprints, and several of the sources that fill the identified gaps (including the uncertainty-preservation, counterfactual, weighted-rubric and judge-reliability studies) had not completed peer review at the time of writing; their findings are treated as provisional and are flagged as such in the reference list. Third, the review is organised against one operational definition of clinical reasoning; instruments that look weak against these six dimensions may be well suited to other constructs, and the coverage judgements in Table 1 should be read relative to the stated construct rather than as verdicts on the tools. Fourth, no quantitative synthesis was attempted, because the instruments reviewed do not share a common outcome, and reported figures (such as inter-rater reliabilities and agreement gains) are quoted from the primary sources without re-analysis.
blocks.zh: 应说明四项限制。 首先,筛选和综合由单一审查员进行,没有双重筛选或正式流程图,因此审查是结构化的叙述性地图,而不是符合PRISMA范围审查。 其次,LLM评价文献主要通过预印来移动,一些填补已查明空白的来源(包括不确定性保留、反事实、加权Rubric和法官-可靠性研究)在撰写本报告时尚未完成同行评审;其结论被视为临时的,并在参考清单中标注。 第三,审查是根据临床推理的一个操作定义组织的;相对于这六个方面看很弱的工具可能非常适合其他结构,表1中的涵盖范围判断应相对于所述结构来理解,而不是作为对工具的判断。 第四,没有试图进行定量综合,因为所审查的文书没有共同的结果,报告的数字(如利率之间可恢复性和协议收益)是在没有重新分析的情况下从主要来源引用的。

blocks.en: 14 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 14 结论

blocks.en:
No instrument identified in this review covers all six dimensions
of clinical reasoning over longitudinal records as defined here. The medical education tradition supplies clinically meaningful
anchors for problem representation and differential reasoning,
together with evidence that reliability depends on the instrument
and assessment setting. The clinical benchmark literature supplies setting-specific designs for temporal reasoning, sequential diagnostic updating, uncertainty preservation, counterfactual perturbation and safety-weighted completeness. The general evaluation-methodology literature supplies the machinery (binary compilation, separated completeness and correctness, importance weighting, order-consistency and chance-corrected reliability) that makes any of this applicable at scale. What remains to be built is the combination: a rubric that scores reasoning over serial records in which later entries supersede earlier ones, that treats calibrated uncertainty and counterfactual robustness as first-class dimensions, and that tests rather than assumes the faithfulness of stated reasoning. The concrete next step is not a larger benchmark but a small, carefully specified instrument whose reliability is established with chance-corrected statistics before any claim about model reasoning is made.
